verses.1: A prayer for David, the LORD: Hear my prayers. Listen to my supplications. Answer me with your righteousness.
verses.2: And do not judge your servants according to your own judgment. For no one can be righteous before you.
verses.3: For the enemy pursued my soul, and it was cast into the earth. But I will be saved in my thoughts, forever.
verses.4: And my soul was enveloped within me, and it became calm in my heart.
verses.5: I remember those days when I worked on all your projects with great effort and dedication.
verses.6: I have stretched out my hands to you, my soul. It’s like a land that is exhausted and in need of rest for you.
verses.7: Hurry, answer me, O LORD! May your spirit not hide your face from me. Then I will be able to stand before you with my hands raised in prayer.
verses.8: Please let me hear of your kindness this morning. For in you I place my trust. Please tell me how to proceed, for it is to you that I am bringing my soul.
verses.9: Save me from my enemies, O LORD! You are my savior.
verses.10: Teach me to do your will, for you are the Lord. May your good spirit guide me in this land.
verses.11: That your name may be Jehovah, and that you may give me life through your righteousness. Then my soul will be saved from trouble.
verses.12: And by your kindness, I will overcome my enemies. All those who harm my soul will be destroyed, for I am your servant.
